guard: every route the dashboard calls reads through the HTTP status gate, so a 500 whose body is JSON is a refusal naming the read and the server's error, never data
why: This suite runs `tsx` directly over `client/src`, with no build step and no compiled second copy, so no `afterRestore` is needed on any mutation here.

mutations.name: H1 the space read (a GET) goes back to consuming the body without the status gate, so a 500 resolves with {error} as the space
mutations.expectRed: 1.1a meta REJECTS a 500 rather than resolving with its body as data
mutations.cell: 1.1a meta REJECTS a 500 rather than resolving with its body as data

mutations.name: H2 the roster read drops the gate
mutations.expectRed: 1.2a roster REJECTS a 500 rather than resolving with its body as data
mutations.cell: 1.2a roster REJECTS a 500 rather than resolving with its body as data

mutations.name: H3 the channel history read (the one behind the open channel) drops the gate
mutations.expectRed: 1.6a history REJECTS a 500 rather than resolving with its body as data
mutations.cell: 1.6a history REJECTS a 500 rather than resolving with its body as data

mutations.name: H4 the membership read drops the gate
mutations.expectRed: 1.7a membership REJECTS a 500 rather than resolving with its body as data
mutations.cell: 1.7a membership REJECTS a 500 rather than resolving with its body as data

mutations.name: H5 the channel delete (the one POST) drops the gate, so a refused delete resolves as though it purged
mutations.find: return readJson<{ ok: true; channel: string; purged: number }>(res, `delete #${channel}`);
mutations.replace: return res.json() as Promise<{ ok: true; channel: string; purged: number }>;
mutations.expectRed: 1.8a deleteChannel REJECTS a 500 rather than resolving with its body as data
mutations.cell: 1.8a deleteChannel REJECTS a 500 rather than resolving with its body as data

mutations.name: H6 the direct-messages read names itself something else, so its refusal no longer says which read failed
mutations.expectRed: 1.5b dms names the read it refused
mutations.cell: 1.5b dms names the read it refused

mutations.name: H7 the history channel is no longer encoded, so a name with a slash, a space or a hash changes the route it asks for
mutations.expectRed: 4.3 history ENCODES the channel with encodeURIComponent
mutations.cell: 4.3 history ENCODES the channel with encodeURIComponent, so a name with a slash, a space or a hash cannot change the route

mutations.name: H8 the activity read stops forwarding the limit the controller asked for
mutations.expectRed: 4.1 the reads hit their own routes, with the limits the controller asked for
mutations.cell: 4.1 the reads hit their own routes, with the limits the controller asked for

mutations.name: H9 the delete is sent as a PUT, so the server's POST route is never reached
H10 the delete stops declaring a JSON body, so the server reads no channel out of it
H11 the delete body is the bare channel name rather than {"channel": ...}
H12 the default fetch is captured when httpApi is built, so a page that swaps its fetch afterwards is not the one that answers
mutations.expectRed: 5.1 with no fetch passed, a request goes through the global fetch as it is when the request is made
mutations.cell: 5.1 with no fetch passed, a request goes through the global fetch as it is when the request is made

mutations.name: H13 the shared status gate is dropped from readJson, so a 500 body parses as data on every route at once
mutations.expectRed: 1.1a meta REJECTS a 500 rather than resolving with its body as data
mutations.cell: 1.1a meta REJECTS a 500 rather than resolving with its body as data
